criteria.description: Assigns a launch tier (T1/T2/T3 or equivalent) rather than just describing activities, and justifies it.

Tiers by user/business IMPACT (fixes a top complaint, makes the product feel faster) rather than by engineering effort/pride or by the fact that it's invisible — i.e. recognizes it warrants a real announcement despite no new UI.
Right-sizes the launch activities/channels to the chosen tier rather than a generic or full-blown plan.
Frames the launch around the user benefit (faster, near-real-time, the complaint resolved) so an invisible change is made visible — not just 'we re-architected sync'.
Notes owners/timeline appropriate to the tier and/or a rollback/risk consideration for an infra change.
